Pavara Vhana Collection

Villa in Layan
HomeSalePavara Vhana Collection

Marketing images, mostly artist renders. Layouts and finishes may differ from the final product.

Project overview

Twenty-two hillside two-storey pool villas on the Layan side of Choeng Thale, built for large-format family living with maid's and study rooms and one or two kitchens. Every villa has its own pool, with sizes and layouts varying by type A to F.

Pavara Vhana Collection: key facts

  • Pavara Vhana Collection is a pool villa in Layan, Phuket, developed by Pavara Development Co., Ltd.
  • Units: 3–5 bedrooms, 812.79–1717.65 sqm.
  • Construction status: under construction; completion listed as Dec 2027.
  • Ownership listed by sources: Leasehold.
  • Advertised starting price: ฿98,000,000.
  • Nearest beach: Layan Beach (1.3 km, straight line).
  • Nearby, according to the project data: Mingle Mall Naiyang (4.8 km); SAii Laguna Phuket (5.2 km); Thalang Hospital Phuket (5.5 km); Bumrungrad Hospital Phuket (8.5 km).

Facilities & amenities

  • 24/7 security
  • CCTV
  • Covered parking
  • Swimming pool with poolside
  • Private pool in each villa
  • Maid's room and study in every villa
